patterns.what_worked: Keeping every new key's effective default at its shipped round state (nil/absent = off, false for the two profile keys) made the wiring behaviour-neutral by construction: no class module was touched, the post-edit harness failure set is byte-identical to the shaman-weave round-2 baseline, and the new options_load_state section 6 turns 'no default-visible change' into a machine check - the M1 default flip is caught by exactly one new check in the full harness (3 failed vs 2 baseline). The shaman-weave round-2 addendum landed mid-pass and was read, wired (2 keys) and pinned before hand-off instead of being deferred.
patterns.what_was_hard: Two report rows are not toggles and not reachable from this pass's writable scope: the druid pips position seam (druid_pips_x/y + save/reset) needs the pips factory (bars.lua) or the druid call site, and the practice aw_includes_pot/sob options have no engine/UI consumer yet. Both are recorded as gaps instead of shipping dead widgets. hud_show_tf/berserk are the hide-on-false shape, so 'nil = OFF' does not apply to them - shipped true like every sibling slot toggle (behaviour identical) and pinned as such.
patterns.skill_gap: The suite pins widget presence, get/set resolution, getter key reads and default sources; it cannot prove a widget's key matches its consumer class-code read (that correspondence is grep-verified and tabled in the report). In-client rendering of the new options pages stays UNCONFIRMED (offline harness cannot open AceConfig).
